label: Slack bot token
name: slack_bot_token
hint: Bot token. Scopes: chat:write (the line posted in the channel when a game is started); channels:join is optional (to join a public channel by itself). views.publish needs no scope of its own.

label: Workato api token
name: workato_api_token
hint: Workato Data Tables API token. Only READS the DiceUp table: this step writes nothing. Without it the page still shows the games, with empty stats.

label: Environment
name: env
hint: Which workspace's DiceUp table to read: dev or prod. Map it from the recipe's environment property. Anything other than dev (blank too) means prod, so production needs nothing set.

label: User ID
name: user_id
hint: [home] The person who opened the home tab: event.user of app_home_opened. Their own stats (Your DiceUp, achievements, journeys) are about this person. [click] Read from payload when blank.

label: Tab
name: tab
hint: [home] event.tab of app_home_opened: home or messages. messages is skipped (nothing is published).

label: Private metadata
name: private_metadata
hint: [home] event.view.private_metadata (optional): keeps the period chosen and the last channel used. [click] Read from payload when blank.

label: Payload
name: payload
hint: [click] The whole block_actions interaction as JSON text (in formula mode, the trigger's object .to_json). With it nothing else but the tokens and env is needed. Its presence (or action_id's) makes this call a click.

label: Action ID
name: action_id
hint: [click] actions[0].action_id, when mapping field by field. Every DiceUp home action id starts with diceup_home_ (filter the click recipe on that).

label: Value
name: value
hint: [click] actions[0].value, when mapping field by field (the game's key on a Start button).

label: Selected channel
name: selected_channel
hint: [click] The channel chosen in the home tab's picker, when mapping field by field (view.state.values ... selected_conversation). Read from payload when blank.

label: Selected period
name: selected_period
hint: [click] actions[0].selected_option.value of the period dropdown, when mapping field by field.

label: Default period
name: period
hint: The period the stats open on when the view has none yet: 7, 30, 90 or all (default all).

toggle_field.label: Default period
toggle_field.name: period
toggle_field.hint: The period the stats open on when the view has none yet: 7, 30, 90 or all (default all).

label: Features
name: features
hint: Which Slack blocks to use: headers, cards, tiles, charts, datatables, tables, rich, panels, adaptive. Blank = all but adaptive. -name takes one away, +name adds one, none = the plain view. A feature Slack refuses is taken out by itself.

label: Top N
name: top_n
hint: Players on each game's winners board, 1 to 25. Default 10.

label: Games JSON
name: games_json
hint: Optional JSON list to change or add games, matched on key (= record_type), e.g. [{"key": "trivia", "name": "Trivia", "emoji": ":brain:", "tagline": "Quick-fire questions", "word": "itrivia", "coming_soon": true}]. {"key": "tambola", "enabled": false} hides one. A game's own journeys can be set here too.

label: Announce start
name: announce_start
hint: [click] yes (default): Start posts a short line in the chosen channel (and joins a public channel it is not in). no: nothing is posted and nothing is checked.

toggle_field.label: Announce start
toggle_field.name: announce_start
toggle_field.hint: [click] yes (default): Start posts a short line in the chosen channel (and joins a public channel it is not in). no: nothing is posted and nothing is checked.

label: Max pages
name: max_pages
hint: Most pages of 200 rows read from the table. Default 50 (10,000 rows); past that the page says the stats are partial.

label: Time budget
name: time_budget
hint: Seconds the step may spend, 10 to 85. Default 60. Reading stops early enough to publish.

label: Preview
name: preview
hint: yes: publish nothing and post nothing; the view comes back in view_json (paste its blocks into Block Kit Builder).

toggle_field.label: Preview
toggle_field.name: preview
toggle_field.hint: yes: publish nothing and post nothing; the view comes back in view_json (paste its blocks into Block Kit Builder).
